feature_flag: watch strip requires exact ?watch=1; storage-map endpoint requires exact runtime binding path+SHA and otherwise returns unavailable
authority_notes: Read-only Owner projection surface on port 4192. The Board consumes guild_hall/watch_panel_contract as its single watch-semantics source and the Path Registry's backup-readiness overlay as a separately declared read dependency. Its storage-map endpoint is loopback GET-only and default-OFF until exact binding bytes, binding SHA, snapshot SHA and registry digest are supplied; it has no writer/repair authority and fabricates no snapshot. Its only watch-side mutation is the contract's request-filing surface, and filing executes nothing. The agent-runtime endpoint remains a coarse aggregate boundary: session rows carry id/key/status/timestamps/message_count/model only, never message or prompt content.
